annotation.evidence_span: Receipt of any other known frame type
annotation.interpretation_a: Any frame type not explicitly allowed after a CONNECT method completion is a connection error.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only frame types defined within the HTTP/3 specification itself are considered 'known'. Frames from extensions, even if registered, are not 'known' and thus do not trigger the error.
annotation.justification: The term 'known frame type' is not defined. It is unclear whether this refers only to the base HTTP/3 frames or also includes frames defined by registered extensions. This impacts whether receiving an extension frame is a connection error or not.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'known frame type' is not provided. Does 'known' include frames defined by registered HTTP/3 extensions, or only those defined in the base specification?
